import cmath

def fft(a):
    n = len(a)
    if n == 1:
        return a
    even = fft(a[0::2])
    odd  = fft(a[1::2])
    result = [0] * n
    for k in range(n // 2):
        t = cmath.exp(-2j * cmath.pi * k / n) * odd[k]
        result[k] = even[k] + t
        result[k + n // 2] = even[k] - t
    return result

out = fft([1, 2, 3, 4])
print([f"{c.real:.1f}{c.imag:+.1f}j" for c in out])
